subject: LanternWorks - request for quarterly invoicing + extended payment window
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@lanternworks.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lanternworks.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: quarterly invoicing + longer payment window (LanternWorks PO attached)

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. Procurement asked me to share LanternWorks' billing constraint: our primary funding comes from a quarterly grant cycle, so we need invoices on a quarterly cadence and a 90-day payment window after invoice date to line up with disbursement schedules.

I've attached our PO (LanternWorks_PO.pdf) and a redline-ready SOW (LanternWorks_SOW_v3.pdf). Before we get legal involved, can Redwood confirm:
- willingness to invoice quarterly for the first year,
- a Net-90 payment term (invoice due 90 days from invoice date),
- any potential prepay or retention you would require?

Because this is a pilot funded by a government grant, LanternWorks cannot move to monthly billing. If Net-90 is not possible, would Redwood accept a 30% upfront + quarterly balance? Also, are you able to offer volume discounting for the first-year commitment?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement would like this in the PO before the grant committee meets on 5/25.

Best,
Elaine Park
Business Operations, LanternWorks
elaine@lanternworks.com
+1 415-555-9182

--- Attachment: LanternWorks_PO.pdf (PDF stub)
--- Attachment: LanternWorks_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF stub)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@lanternworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: quarterly invoicing + longer payment window (LanternWorks PO attached)

Hi Elaine — thanks for the note and for sending the PO/SOW. We're excited to work with LanternWorks. Short answers up front: we can do quarterly invoicing for the pilot, but Net-90 is an exception to our standard terms and needs exec/finance clearance.

Proposed structure we can present for approval:
- 30% upfront at contract signature (applied to first invoice) to reduce credit exposure,
- Quarterly invoicing thereafter, with invoices due Net-90 as requested by LanternWorks (exception request),
- In exchange for the extended terms, Redwood would provide a one-time 7% first-year discount on subscription fees,
- Include an escrow-style clause for milestone-based release (optional) if legal/finance prefers additional protection.

I'll loop in Laura (finance) and Jonas (sales leader) for quick review; if they sign off we can mark this in the PO and route the SOW to Legal/Docs for a limited-term amendment.

Laura/Jonas — can you confirm if Finance can accept Net-90 with 30% prepay + the 7% concession? If not, please suggest an alternative (e.g., 45-day term or escrow). Need final decision by 5/20 to make LanternWorks' 5/25 committee deadline.

Thanks —
David
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai
+1 650-555-3022
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: quarterly invoicing + longer payment window (LanternWorks PO attached)

David / Jonas — reviewed LanternWorks' ask and the proposed concession. Summary and risk notes below (see attached spreadsheet for line-item impact):

Summary assessment:
- Net-90 materially increases Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and credit risk for a startup customer on grant funding.
- 30% prepay materially mitigates immediate exposure but does not remove longer-term bad-debt risk.
- A one-time 7% discount is acceptable from a margin standpoint for the pilot, but requires documented approval for pipeline reporting.

Mitigations we recommend (pick one):
1) Approve Net-90 with conditions: require 30% prepay, include escrow milestone clause (legal to confirm wording), and add monthly usage caps to limit exposure; finance will place the deal on a 90-day reserve for revenue recognition until payment clears.
2) If Execs are uncomfortable, counter with Net-45 plus 30% prepay and the 7% concession. Net-45 reduces DSO and is a reasonable compromise.
3) Require a signed irrevocable PO and a corporate guarantee from their parent (if available) before Net-90 is allowed.

Action items for approval:
- Exec signoff needed: allow Net-90 vs Net-45; approve 7% first-year discount; confirm requirement for 30% prepay and optional escrow.
- Legal: quick SOW amendment to codify invoicing cadence, prepay treatment, and escrow/milestones.

Attachment: billing_risk_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

I'll be available for a 15-min sync today at 3pm PT if you want to walk through the P&L impact.

— Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine@lanternworks.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: quarterly invoicing + longer payment window (LanternWorks PO attached)

Team / Elaine — after reviewing the proposal and Laura's risk notes, I am approving the following one-time exception for LanternWorks' pilot:

Approved:
- Quarterly invoicing with Net-90 payment terms (exception granted)
- 30% prepay at signature required and must be wired before first invoice is issued
- One-time 7% discount applied to subscription fees for year one
- Legal to produce an amendment to the SOW that includes an escrow clause and a monthly usage cap (to be effective for the pilot only)
- Finance will place a 90-day reserve for revenue until the first invoice clears

Conditions/Notes:
- This exception is valid only for Deal DL-47219 and the first 12 months of the contract; future renewals revert to standard payment terms unless a formal waiver is granted.
- If LanternWorks fails to remit the 30% prepay within 7 business days of signature, the exception is void.
- Laura: work with Legal to finalize amendment; David: confirm wiring instructions with Elaine and update the PO.

Elaine — congrats, we'll proceed under the approved terms. David will send the final amendment and payment instructions this afternoon.

Jonas Weber
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
